claims.text: In one clinic population, weekly use of a seizure diary app fell from 61 percent at one month to 14 percent at twelve months.
claims.passage: At one month, 61 percent were engaged; at six months, 23 percent; at twelve months, 14 percent.
claims.interpretation: Engagement decays steeply; duration must be charted, not only uptake.

claims.text: Studies of neurological self-management apps used 23 different engagement measures.
claims.interpretation: Definitions must be charted before any comparison.

claims.text: Adults who stopped using epilepsy apps cited the effort of entries, poor fit with irregular seizures, privacy worries and no clinician response to their reports.
claims.passage: Reasons included the effort of daily entries, apps that did not fit irregular seizure patterns, worry about who could see the data, and a lack of response from clinicians to the reports.
claims.interpretation: Support from clinicians is a feature to chart alongside app features.

claims.text: Smartphone ownership among people with epilepsy was 58 percent over age 65 and 64 percent in the lowest income quintile.
claims.passage: ownership was 58 percent among those aged over 65 and 64 percent among those in the lowest income quintile
claims.interpretation: Non-engagement starts with access; chart who was offered an app.

synthesis: Seven retrieved records, appraised at abstract level. Engagement with epilepsy self-management apps falls steeply over months, is measured in many incompatible ways, and has not been linked to seizure outcomes in trials. People stop for reasons of effort, fit, privacy and the absence of clinician response, and many older or low-income people lack a smartphone in the first place. Reminder use goes with better adherence in one small study. The field is fragmented and definitional, which suits mapping rather than pooling.
gradeRationale: Observational and qualitative studies and one trial review with inconsistent engagement definitions; low certainty for any link between engagement and outcomes.
summary: Seven retrieved records appraised; four claims with passages; certainty low.
